Figure 1: Overview of the proposed MSDE anomaly detection pipeline. (a) Medical images are embedded into 512-dimensional feature space using pretrained backbones (AnatPaste for chest Xrays, ResNet18 for other modalities). (b) Extracted features undergo iterative manifold shifting via MSDE, which compacts normal clusters through weighted neighborhood aggregation. (c) PCA reduces dimensionality to 256, followed by Gaussian density estimation. (d) Anomaly scores are computed via Mahalanobis distance, with higher scores indicating greater likelihood of pathology.
